body:
B5-selftest-window is ready for review: origin/wp/B5-selftest-window at a9828759, one commit on dd2cf300. Swift only.

- SelfTestHost (App/SelfTestHost.swift) runs once from applicationDidFinishLaunching, only when --nonactivating is combined with a document self-test flag. It covers all 10 --*-selftest flags in both forms, plus the TESSERA_{CHANNELS,TEXT,STACK}_SELFTEST env vars.
  - If no window is visible after 0.3 s, it hosts the app content in a regular window that can never become key or main and sits behind all apps. No orderFront, no makeKey, no activate.
  - It then starts the requested self-tests directly, so --new-document is no longer needed. It opens a blank document for channels and text.
- The transform-local window from 12b is replaced by SelfTestHost.ensureWindow.
- orderFrontRegardless() screenshot raises go through SelfTestHost.raiseForCapture, which is a no-op in background runs.
- Every early exit now logs FAIL and counts, so no silent "0 failure(s)".

Background results (`open -g -n … --nonactivating`; the frontmost app stayed the same before and after):
- transform: 0 failures (61 ok)
- channels: 0 failures (19)
- camera-raw: 0 failures (9)
- channel-paint: 0 failures (22)
- vector: 1 FAILURE (88 ok). On main this printed nothing at all. The failing check is step 372, "fill-only drag previews coalesce to frames": it needs at least 5 latency samples and got 1. That's likely because a behind-all-apps window gets few display frames during the 60 Hz synthetic drag. That frame-count check can't pass in a background window, so B proposes skipping it in background runs and checking it in your on-screen pass. Tell me if you want that change in this branch.
Not run: retouch, filter, styles, tools, document, liquify, text, stack.

SWIFT GATE OK with 778 tests, including new SelfTestHostTests. The HANDOFF has the launch recipe, and run-background-selftest.sh <name> wraps it: it checks the frontmost app before and after and kills only its own PID.

Waiting on your review: B5-17d 61b6bdb4, B5-19b 1051580f, B5-18b 117b44f8, B5-selftest-window a9828759. B5-20 still waits on your answer to 8451c9fa.
